Loading libraries

```{r libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(DESeq2)
library(plotly)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(UpSetR)
library(venneuler)
library(grid)


```


Import and wrangle data

```{r wrangle}

setwd("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/main_screen/")

zfp36l2_counts <- read_csv("ZFP36L2-KD_NNRCO-DS-P232_deseq2_results.csv")
pygo2_counts <- read_csv("PYGO2-KD_NNRCO-DS-P232_deseq2_results.csv")
ppp_counts <- read_csv("PPP2R5A-KD_NNRCO-DS-P232_deseq2_results.csv")

head(zfp36l2_counts)

summary(zfp36l2_counts)

zfp36l2_counts <- zfp36l2_counts[order(zfp36l2_counts$padj),] 

# why do some of them have padj values and some do not?

zfp_na <- zfp36l2_counts %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(padj))

max(zfp_na$baseMean)

hist(zfp36l2_counts$baseMean, xlim = c(0, 200), breaks = 20000)

```


Volcano plot?

```{r volcanoes}


with(zfp36l2_counts, plot(log2FoldChange, -log10(pvalue), pch=20, main="Volcano plot", xlim=c(-3,3)))

# Add colored points: blue if padj<0.01, red if log2FC>1 and padj<0.05)
with(subset(zfp36l2_counts, padj<.01 ), points(log2FoldChange, -log10(pvalue), pch=20, col="blue"))
with(subset(zfp36l2_counts, padj<.01 & abs(log2FoldChange)>2), points(log2FoldChange, -log10(pvalue), pch=20, col="red"))






# make the Plot.ly plot
p <- plot_ly(data = zfp36l2_counts, x = zfp36l2_counts$log2FoldChange, y = -log10(zfp36l2_counts$pvalue), text = zfp36l2_counts$gene) 
p
#pygo2
py <- plot_ly(data = pygo2_counts, x = pygo2_counts$log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pygo2_counts$pvalue), text = pygo2_counts$gene) 
py
#ppp2r5a
ppp <- plot_ly(data = ppp_counts, x = ppp_counts$log2FoldChange, y = -log10(ppp_counts$pvalue), text = ppp_counts$gene) 
ppp
# check enhancedvolcanoplots


library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# Define gene symbols
gene_symbols <- zfp36l2_counts$gene

gene_symbols_pygo <- pygo2_counts$gene

gene_symbols_ppp <- ppp_counts$gene

# Map symbols to gene descriptions/full names
gene_desc <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = gene_symbols,
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    column = "GENENAME",
    multiVals = "first"
) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene_description = ".")

gene_desc$gene <- row.names(gene_desc)

zfp36l2_counts_named <- left_join(zfp36l2_counts, gene_desc)

# pygo
gene_desc_pygo <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = gene_symbols_pygo,
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    column = "GENENAME",
    multiVals = "first"
) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene_description = ".")

gene_desc_pygo$gene <- row.names(gene_desc_pygo)

pygo_counts_named <- left_join(pygo2_counts, gene_desc_pygo)


# ppp
gene_desc_ppp <- mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys = gene_symbols_ppp,
    keytype = "SYMBOL",
    column = "GENENAME",
    multiVals = "first"
) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene_description = ".")

gene_desc_ppp$gene <- row.names(gene_desc_ppp)

ppp_counts_named <- left_join(ppp_counts, gene_desc_ppp)



```

```{r enhancedvolcano}


### ZFP36L2

#find most top 10 significant genes and label
# zfp_top_10_padj <- zfp36l2_counts[order(zfp36l2_counts$padj),]
# zfp_top_10_padj <- zfp_top_10_padj[abs(zfp_top_10_padj$log2FoldChange) >= 0.58 & zfp_top_10_padj$padj < 0.05] %>% 
#     dplyr::slice_min(n = 10, order_by = zfp_top_10_padj$padj)


zfp_top_10_padj <- zfp36l2_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), abs(log2FoldChange) >= 0.58, padj < 0.05 ) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min( order_by = padj,n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)


EnhancedVolcano(zfp36l2_counts,
                lab = zfp36l2_counts$gene,
                x = 'log2FoldChange',
                y = 'padj',
                selectLab = zfp_top_10_padj$gene,
                xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ 'fold change'),
                pCutoff = 0.05,
                FCcutoff = 0.58,
                pointSize = 4.0,
                labSize = 6.0,
                labCol = 'black',
                labFace = 'bold',
                boxedLabels = TRUE,
                colAlpha = 4/5,
                legendPosition = 'right',
                legendLabSize = 14,
                legendIconSize = 4.0,
                legendLabels = c("NS", expression(Log[2] ~ FC), "adjusted p-val", expression(adj ~ p - val ~ and
                                                                                             ~ log[2] ~ FC)),
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                widthConnectors = 1.0,
                colConnectors = 'black')

# saved as ZFP36L2_enhanced_volcano_top10 png and svg, dimensions 1200*700
```

```{r gseaforplots}

# stat is the Wald statistic

### ZFP36L2

zfp_ranks <- zfp36l2_counts$stat
names(zfp_ranks) <- zfp36l2_counts$gene
zfp_ranks <- sort(zfp_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

hallmark_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
hallmark_list <- split(hallmark_df$gene_symbol, hallmark_df$gs_name)

fgsea_zfp <- fgsea(
    pathways = hallmark_list,
    stats = zfp_ranks,
    minSize = 15,
    maxSize = 500
)

fgsea_zfp <- fgsea_zfp[order(fgsea_zfp$padj), ]
fgsea_tbl <- as.data.frame(fgsea_zfp)

fgsea_tbl <- fgsea_tbl %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    mutate(
        log10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
        pathway_clean = gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", pathway))
    )

top_up <- fgsea_tbl %>%
    filter(NES > 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)

top_down <- fgsea_tbl %>%
    filter(NES < 0) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)

top_fgsea <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    mutate(
        pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES),
        significant = padj < 0.05
    )

p_fgsea_bar <- top_fgsea %>% 
    dplyr::filter(significant == TRUE) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = pathway_clean, y = NES, fill = significant)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "#B31B21", "FALSE" = "grey75"),
        labels = c("TRUE" = "padj < 0.05", "FALSE" = "padj >= 0.05"),
        breaks = c("TRUE", "FALSE"),
        name = "Significant"
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "FGSEA: top enriched pathways in ZFP36L2 knockdown",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()+
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))


p_fgsea_bar

#save as ZFP36L2_GSEA png and svg 1200x700 pdf 12x7 landscape inches
```

```{r fgseaiterations}

# =========================================================
# FGSEA for multiple knockdowns across:
#   1) Hallmark
#   2) Reactome
#   3) GO Biological Process
#
# Creates, for each knockdown x collection:
#   - fgsea result table
#   - bar plot
#   - dot plot
#   - top single enrichment curve
#   - panel of top enrichment curves
#
# Also creates, for each knockdown:
#   - combined side-by-side bar plot:
#       Hallmark | Reactome | GO BP
#   - combined side-by-side dot plot:
#       Hallmark | Reactome | GO BP
#   - combined side-by-side top enrichment curves
#
# Assumptions:
#   - each DE table has columns called `gene` and `stat`
#   - `gene` contains human gene symbols
#
# If your `msigdbr()` version complains about `category` / `subcategory`,
# replace them with `collection` / `subcollection`.
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# 1. ADD YOUR KNOCKDOWN TABLES HERE
# -------------------------
kd_tables <- list(
    ZFP36L2 = zfp36l2_counts,
    PYGO2 = pygo2_counts,
    PPP2R5A = ppp_counts
)

# -------------------------
# 2. SETTINGS
# -------------------------
species_name <- "Homo sapiens"
gene_col <- "gene"
rank_col <- "stat"

min_size <- 15
max_size <- 500

# Fewer pathways can make plots much clearer
top_n_bar <- 8
top_n_dot <- 15
top_n_curves <- 4

# Label/plot size controls
label_wrap_width <- 28     # smaller = more line breaks in pathway names
axis_text_size <- 8
plot_title_size <- 11
plot_subtitle_size <- 9
legend_text_size <- 8
legend_title_size <- 9
base_font_size <- 10

# Optional label shortening
abbreviate_labels <- TRUE

# -------------------------
# 3. LOAD GENE SET COLLECTIONS
# -------------------------
hallmark_df <- msigdbr(species = species_name, category = "H")
reactome_df <- msigdbr(species = species_name, category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")
gobp_df <- msigdbr(species = species_name, category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")

gene_sets <- list(
    Hallmark = split(hallmark_df$gene_symbol, hallmark_df$gs_name),
    Reactome = split(reactome_df$gene_symbol, reactome_df$gs_name),
    GO_BP = split(gobp_df$gene_symbol, gobp_df$gs_name)
)

# -------------------------
# 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# -------------------------
clean_pathway_names <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("^(HALLMARK|REACTOME|GOBP|GO_BP)_", "", x)
    x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
    x
}

shorten_labels <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("^POSITIVE REGULATION OF ", "POS REG OF ", x)
    x <- gsub("^NEGATIVE REGULATION OF ", "NEG REG OF ", x)
    x <- gsub("^REGULATION OF ", "REG OF ", x)
    x <- gsub("TRANSCRIPTION", "TXN", x)
    x <- gsub("PHOSPHORYLATION", "PHOSPH.", x)
    x <- gsub("ORGANIZATION", "ORG.", x)
    x <- gsub("BIOSYNTHETIC", "BIOSYN", x)
    x
}

format_pathway_labels <- function(x, wrap_width = 28, abbreviate = TRUE) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    if (abbreviate) {
        x <- shorten_labels(x)
    }
    stringr::str_wrap(x, width = wrap_width)
}

make_ranks <- function(df, gene_col = "gene", rank_col = "stat") {
    df2 <- df %>%
        dplyr::select(gene = all_of(gene_col), stat = all_of(rank_col)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(gene), !is.na(stat)) %>%
        group_by(gene) %>%
        slice_max(order_by = abs(stat), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
        ungroup()
    
    ranks <- df2$stat
    names(ranks) <- df2$gene
    ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
    return(ranks)
}

run_fgsea_one <- function(ranks, pathways, kd_name, collection_name,
                          min_size = 15, max_size = 500,
                          top_n_bar = 8, top_n_dot = 15, top_n_curves = 4,
                          label_wrap_width = 28, abbreviate_labels = TRUE,
                          axis_text_size = 8, plot_title_size = 11,
                          plot_subtitle_size = 9, legend_text_size = 8,
                          legend_title_size = 9, base_font_size = 10) {
    
    fg <- fgsea(
        pathways = pathways,
        stats = ranks,
        minSize = min_size,
        maxSize = max_size
    )
    
    fg <- fg[order(fg$padj, fg$pval), ]
    
    fg_tbl <- as.data.frame(fg) %>%
        filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
        mutate(
            log10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
            pathway_clean = clean_pathway_names(pathway)
        )
    
    if (nrow(fg_tbl) == 0) {
        return(list(
            result = fg,
            table = fg_tbl,
            bar = NULL,
            dot = NULL,
            curve_top1 = NULL,
            curve_topN = NULL
        ))
    }
    
    n_bar_fallback <- min(2 * top_n_bar, nrow(fg_tbl))
    n_dot_plot <- min(top_n_dot, nrow(fg_tbl))
    n_curve_plot <- min(top_n_curves, nrow(fg_tbl))
    
    top_up <- fg_tbl %>%
        filter(NES > 0) %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        slice_head(n = top_n_bar)
    
    top_down <- fg_tbl %>%
        filter(NES < 0) %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        slice_head(n = top_n_bar)
    
    top_bar <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
    
    if (nrow(top_bar) == 0) {
        top_bar <- fg_tbl %>%
            arrange(padj) %>%
            slice_head(n = n_bar_fallback)
    }
    
    top_bar <- top_bar %>%
        mutate(pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES))
    
    p_bar <- ggplot(top_bar, aes(x = pathway_clean, y = NES, fill = NES > 0)) +
        geom_col() +
        coord_flip() +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
            format_pathway_labels(
                x,
                wrap_width = label_wrap_width,
                abbreviate = abbreviate_labels
            )
        }) +
        scale_fill_manual(
            values = c("TRUE" = "#D55E00", "FALSE" = "#0072B2"),
            labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative NES", "TRUE" = "Positive NES")
        ) +
        labs(
            title = paste0(kd_name, " | ", collection_name),
            subtitle = "FGSEA top enriched pathways",
            x = NULL,
            y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
            fill = "Direction"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
        theme(
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
            plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = plot_subtitle_size),
            legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
            legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size)
        )
    
    top_dot <- fg_tbl %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_dot_plot) %>%
        mutate(pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES))
    
    p_dot <- ggplot(top_dot, aes(x = NES, y = pathway_clean)) +
        geom_point(aes(size = size, color = log10padj)) +
        scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) {
            format_pathway_labels(
                x,
                wrap_width = label_wrap_width,
                abbreviate = abbreviate_labels
            )
        }) +
        scale_color_viridis_c() +
        labs(
            title = paste0(kd_name, " | ", collection_name),
            subtitle = "FGSEA top pathways",
            x = "NES",
            y = NULL,
            color = "-log10 adjusted p-value",
            size = "Gene set size"
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
        theme(
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
            plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = plot_subtitle_size),
            legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
            legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size)
        )
    
    top_pathway <- fg_tbl %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        pull(pathway)
    
    p_curve_top1 <- fgsea::plotEnrichment(pathways[[top_pathway]], ranks) +
        labs(
            title = paste0(kd_name, " | ", collection_name),
            subtitle = format_pathway_labels(
                clean_pathway_names(top_pathway),
                wrap_width = label_wrap_width,
                abbreviate = abbreviate_labels
            )
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(size = plot_subtitle_size)
        )
    
    curve_pathways <- fg_tbl %>%
        arrange(padj) %>%
        slice_head(n = n_curve_plot) %>%
        pull(pathway)
    
    curve_list <- lapply(curve_pathways, function(pw) {
        fgsea::plotEnrichment(pathways[[pw]], ranks) +
            labs(
                title = format_pathway_labels(
                    clean_pathway_names(pw),
                    wrap_width = label_wrap_width,
                    abbreviate = abbreviate_labels
                ),
                subtitle = paste0(kd_name, " | ", collection_name)
            ) +
            theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
            theme(
                plot.title = element_text(size = plot_title_size, face = "bold"),
                plot.subtitle = element_text(size = plot_subtitle_size)
            )
    })
    
    p_curve_topN <- wrap_plots(curve_list, ncol = 1)
    
    return(list(
        result = fg,
        table = fg_tbl,
        bar = p_bar,
        dot = p_dot,
        curve_top1 = p_curve_top1,
        curve_topN = p_curve_topN
    ))
}

make_side_by_side_plot <- function(one_kd_out, plot_type = c("bar", "dot", "curve_top1"), kd_name = NULL) {
    plot_type <- match.arg(plot_type)
    collections <- c("Hallmark", "Reactome", "GO_BP")
    
    plot_list <- lapply(collections, function(collection_name) {
        p <- one_kd_out[[collection_name]][[plot_type]]
        if (is.null(p)) {
            return(patchwork::plot_spacer())
        } else {
            return(p)
        }
    })
    
    wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3) +
        plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
        theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# -------------------------
# 5. RUN FGSEA FOR ALL KNOCKDOWNS x ALL COLLECTIONS
# -------------------------
fgsea_outputs <- lapply(names(kd_tables), function(kd_name) {
    ranks <- make_ranks(
        df = kd_tables[[kd_name]],
        gene_col = gene_col,
        rank_col = rank_col
    )
    
    out <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(collection_name) {
        run_fgsea_one(
            ranks = ranks,
            pathways = gene_sets[[collection_name]],
            kd_name = kd_name,
            collection_name = collection_name,
            min_size = min_size,
            max_size = max_size,
            top_n_bar = top_n_bar,
            top_n_dot = top_n_dot,
            top_n_curves = top_n_curves,
            label_wrap_width = label_wrap_width,
            abbreviate_labels = abbreviate_labels,
            axis_text_size = axis_text_size,
            plot_title_size = plot_title_size,
            plot_subtitle_size = plot_subtitle_size,
            legend_text_size = legend_text_size,
            legend_title_size = legend_title_size,
            base_font_size = base_font_size
        )
    })
    
    names(out) <- names(gene_sets)
    return(out)
})

names(fgsea_outputs) <- names(kd_tables)

# -------------------------
# 6. MAKE SIDE-BY-SIDE COLLECTION PLOTS FOR EACH KNOCKDOWN
# -------------------------
combined_plots <- lapply(names(fgsea_outputs), function(kd_name) {
    one_kd_out <- fgsea_outputs[[kd_name]]
    
    combined_bar <- make_side_by_side_plot(
        one_kd_out = one_kd_out,
        plot_type = "bar",
        kd_name = kd_name
    ) + plot_annotation(title = paste0(kd_name, " | FGSEA summary across collections"))
    
    combined_dot <- make_side_by_side_plot(
        one_kd_out = one_kd_out,
        plot_type = "dot",
        kd_name = kd_name
    ) + plot_annotation(title = paste0(kd_name, " | FGSEA top pathways across collections"))
    
    combined_curve_top1 <- make_side_by_side_plot(
        one_kd_out = one_kd_out,
        plot_type = "curve_top1",
        kd_name = kd_name
    ) + plot_annotation(title = paste0(kd_name, " | Top enrichment curve in each collection"))
    
    list(
        bar = combined_bar,
        dot = combined_dot,
        curve_top1 = combined_curve_top1
    )
})

names(combined_plots) <- names(fgsea_outputs)
```
